Custom Size Order: ​Another smooth transaction! The shelf was shipped quickly, packed with great care, and arrived in absolute mint condition. The craftsmanship is fantastic for the price point. Outstanding customer service and communication—highly recommend this shop!

The item arrived exceptionally well packaged and in mint condition, shipped via the United States Postal Service. The shelf itself is made of high-quality materials—it is sturdy, strong, and even comes with the necessary anchors and screws for the stands. Ken, the owner of the store, is fantastic; he is quick to respond, accommodates custom orders, and makes wonderful stands. I am very happy and pleased with my purchase. As a returning customer, I will definitely keep coming back as long as this store is available! I highly recommend this store to anyone who comes across this shop.
